product.name: Project Context Protocol
product.tagline: Give every AI project a durable operating context.
product.oneLiner: A portable file-based protocol for instructions, knowledge, skills, decisions, constraints, and current state.
product.principle: Chats are working sessions. Project files are durable operating context.

hero.headline: Stop restarting your AI project every chat.
hero.subheadline: Project Context Protocol gives any LLM a structured way to recover what matters, respect prior decisions, and continue from the latest verified state.

contextTypes.name: Knowledge
contextTypes.description: Facts, architecture, specifications, and source material.

contextTypes.name: State
contextTypes.description: The latest verified checkpoint, decisions, constraints, and next action.
